method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 130 dpi and read each ask page in full; zoomed clips with PyMuPDF (160-800 dpi) on every block and every glyph in doubt: bullets at the left margin of each lead-in, the full stop (or none) after each excerpt heading, curly quotes and apostrophes (‘nothing really matters to me’, Tchaikovsky’s), en dashes (bars 1–26, bars 1–6, 16–bar in composing Q1 vs 16-bar in Q3), the superscripts in AA¹BB¹ (800 dpi) and the drawn flat in A♭ major (350 dpi), the spacing in "No.1" / "No. 1" / "No.78", "No.78", accents (Neainsín Bhán, céilí), and the case of every title and of PREPARATORY WORK (full capitals, regular weight). Cross-checked the words against the text layer (which drops "ti"/"ft" ligatures and the superscripts but is otherwise sound). Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets as "\n• ", " • " only between printed bullet lines, a space for unbulleted lines, tick boxes as "□ ") and compared each file string exactly after collapsing runs of spaces; checked the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings. Elective asks and composing grid stems were outside the brief and are not recorded (the composing stems "Answer one question only in this section: Q1 or Q2 or Q3." / "...: Q4 or Q5 or Q6." match the print). The file has no readFromPage entries.
